name: Sage Sneaker Store Site
description: Create an editable sneaker storefront with a bold citron identity, a compact product-led hero, scannable listings, practical fit details, and a clear shopping path.
whatYouGet: Responsive storefront page with product hero and collection listings
Editable product details, prices, colors, and size options
Fit, materials, shipping, and returns content
goodFit: Independent sneaker labels launching a small collection
Brand designers presenting a shoppable site concept

faq.q: Can I replace the sample products?
faq.a: Yes. Product names, images, colors, prices, and sizes should be stored in clearly editable data.
It can link to an existing commerce checkout or implement the supplied platform integration; it should not imply that payments are supported without one.

demoPrompt: /sl-sage-sneaker-store-site Build Sage Steps for everyday sneaker shoppers: a split hero titled “The Vale Runner” with sample price $118, four sample styles, three material benefits, Vale details, a three-step buying guide, FAQ, newsletter and shop/help/about links, in that order. End with “First look at what's next” and “Join the list.” Use the citron shoebox grid style.
followUpPrompts: Add a product-detail view with a size guide and multiple image angles.
Connect the cart to my existing commerce checkout.
Replace the sample catalog with my product data and photography.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
